title: Middle open facing a blind 3-bet
keyIdea: In position against the blinds: call with pairs, suited broadways and good suited connectors; 4-bet value hands and a few bluffs.

actions.call: JJ-55, AQs-A9s, KQs-KTs, QJs-QTs, JTs, T9s, 98s, AQo, KQo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
